title: Dual Optimal: Make Your LLM Peer-like with Dignity

bias_targets.methodology: Using the Many-Facet Rasch Model (MFRM) based on Item Response Theory (IRT) to calibrate multi-judge ratings, mathematically disentangling a model's true capability from the systematic severity or leniency of individual LLM evaluators (judges), as well as rubric and question difficulty.
